searchText: Proposing 7732 to be included in fusaka: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9291 <@363800010518822915> interested at what stages does Prysm calls fCU in ePBS, or mostly the logic was kept untouched For processing cosensus block is still the same. We call FCU on a new head. This is the same as before For processing execution payload, we would call FCU + attribute for proposing next slot. This is newly added. I think we could get rid of the consensus block FCU and just always use to execution payload FCU but we didnt do that in the interest of time cc <@755590043632140352> to fact check, he coded this part We don't call FCU on the block most of the time Because a new block most of the time will not change the head Makes sense, thanks for the answer! Similar to my thinking

excerpts.author: stefanbratanov
excerpts.content: <@363800010518822915> interested at what stages does Prysm calls fCU in ePBS, or mostly the logic was kept untouched

excerpts.author: terencechain
excerpts.content:
For processing cosensus block is still the same. We call FCU on a new head. This is the same as before
For processing execution payload, we would call FCU + attribute for proposing next slot. This is newly added. 
I think we could get rid of the consensus block FCU and just always use to execution payload FCU but we didnt do that in the interest of time
cc <@755590043632140352> to fact check, he coded this part

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: We don't call FCU on the block most of the time

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: Because a new block most of the time will not change the head
